description: Song questions asked live, the delivered page measured for the song timeline's stops against library facts: whether a song card and timeline appear, how many stops carry the model's label and reason, how widely they span the song's life and whether they reach beyond first, last and longest, whether every debut, last, longest, length and venue claim in a stop is true, and whether a question naming a year opens on it. Nothing here is expected of the model; it measures. Run with scripts/stop_eval.py; each case is one live model turn.
